notes: The marginal gloss (*Hebrew daughters*) was read and set aside; *towns* is what is aligned (rule 38).
Variant unit WLC.JDG.1.27.v001 is underdetermined and its base fallback stands among the readings the English permits, so no rule 53 note is owed (rule 9).

The two italic supplies before Beth-shean and Taanach are `added`: each stands before a bare marked place name and continues an English head noun the Hebrew never writes there, while the four later *the inhabitants of* phrases each answer to a written participle.
